parsed.summary: I re-checked the diff against the code. The `Object.hasOwn(cmd._optionValueSources, key)` check is correct. `setOptionValueWithSource` always assigns the key, so a global option with an undefined source now masks the local source, as the PR intends. `Object.hasOwn` is available because package.json requires Node >=22.12. The new test covers the undefined-source case. I didn't run the test suite. I found no issues.
